'''Fierce Competition at the Pokémon Quiz Battle!!''' (Japanese: '''激闘、ポケモンクイズバトル！！''' ''Fierce Competition at the Pokémon Quiz Battle!!'') is the twenty-fourth chapter of the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{PPM|Red}} and {{PPM|Green}} meet [[Blaine]].
* Blaine challenges Red to a Pokémon quiz where if he gets the quiz wrong, Blaine will send out a Pokémon.
